name: Perron Hotel Baku
description:
Sign in to unlock the members-only price for your selected dates at Perron Hotel Baku


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

About this propertyComfortable Accommodations: Perron Hotel Baku in Baku offers family rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and city views. Each room includes a work desk, TV, and free WiFi.

Convenient Facilities: Guests benefit from free WiFi, private check-in and check-out, a 24-hour front desk, concierge service, and a minimarket. Additional services include room service, bike and car hire, and a tour desk.

Prime Location: Located a 7-minute walk from Maiden Tower and less than 1 km from Palace of The Shirvanshahs, the hotel is near Freedom Square and Azerbaijan Carpet Museum. Heydar Aliyev International Airport is 25 km away. An ice-skating rink is in the surroundings.Solo travellers particularly like the location — they rated it 9.4 for a one-person stay.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap
fine_print: Guests are required to show a photo identification and credit card upon check-in. Please note that all Special Requests are subject to availability and additional charges may apply.Please inform Perron Hotel Baku in advance of your expected arrival time. You can use the Special Requests box when booking, or contact the property directly with the contact details provided in your confirmation.Guests under the age of 18 can only check in with a parent or official guardian.In response to Coronavirus (COVID-19), additional safety and sanitation measures are in effect at this property.
